en.headline: Hang Seng slips about 240 points after Federal Reserve hike
en.dek: By mid-morning the index was near 24,473, down almost 1 per cent from Wednesday’s close, as investors weighed the first US rate rise since 2023.
body: Hong Kong stocks fell in morning trade on Thursday after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates by a quarter point and the Hong Kong Monetary Authority lifted the local Base Rate to 4.25 per cent.

Market data around 10.35am showed the Hang Seng Index at 24,472.51, down 241.27 points or 0.98 per cent from Wednesday’s close of about 24,714. The Hang Seng Tech Index was 1.32 per cent lower and the property sub-index was down 1.81 per cent. Turnover at that point was about HK$70.1 billion.

The index had opened lower after a weaker night session in Hang Seng futures. The fall followed Wednesday’s modest gain of 46 points, when chip and gold-related shares had helped the market hold up ahead of the Federal Reserve decision.
The market remained open at the time of writing. Individual bank prime rates are set separately from the HKMA Base Rate and had not been reported as changed in the morning.

zh.headline: 恒指早段跌約240點 市場消化美息上調
zh.dek: 周四上午近10時35分，恒生指數報24,473點，較周三收市跌近1%，投資者消化美國三年來首次加息。
body: 港股周四早段下跌。美國聯儲局加息四分一厘後，金管局已將基本利率調高至4.25厘，市場開市後跟隨向下。
上午約10時35分的行情顯示，恒生指數報24,472.51點，跌241.27點或0.98%，較周三收市約24,714點回落。恒生科技指數跌1.32%，地產分類指數跌1.81%，當時成交約701億元。
恒指期貨夜市已先走弱，現貨開市低開。周三恒指仍升46點，芯片及黃金相關股份曾抵銷部分加息前的壓力。
截稿時股市仍在交易。金管局基本利率與各銀行最優惠利率分開決定，早上未見銀行公布調整最優惠利率。
